analysis_points: Positioning of the subject (prominent in the foreground or miniscule in the background) …
Here, the compositionally dominating image of…
By positioning X in the foreground/background/centre/side of the *type of image*, author attempts to establish dominance/inferiority of X in *issue*.
The stark contrast between the darker/lighter foreground and the darker/lighter in the image employed by the writer serves to arouse an awareness/sensation of …
Colours (dull being emotionless, bright being full of joy etc., contrast between cold and hot colours)
By deploying ominous/propitious *type of colours* the author accentuates the *target emotion* of *the issue*
Facial expressions and body language: Through X’s prominent/contorted *facial expression/body language*, the author seeks to visually reflect the emotions of *the issue*
examples: The image showcases a drone at a compositionally dominating angle as such, it sets a focal point on the potential destruction that can be imposed on Byways caused by misuse of drones.

Further amplified through by the grey atmosphere of the patchy skies and dull grass, the image is presented in the ominous colour scheme of black and white that pointedly highlights the potential concerns and repercussions to come for the future of Byways. Bandle portrays this image to prompt councillors and residents of Byways who are preservative of their property to take caution and diligence towards using such devices.
